law.title: Stopping, standing or parking in alley (1)(a)
law.text: Unless otherwise provided by ordinance of the local authority having jurisdiction, a person shall not: Stop, stand or park a vehicle within an alley in a business district except for the expeditious loading or unloading of goods.
